snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - Unaccomplished ver. 。！！！
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- Eyestrain
- Violence
- Scopophobia

Read more about this game: https://yume.wiki/unaccomplished/Unaccomplished_Wiki
Download: https://moucky233.itch.io/unaccomplished
Play online/multiplayer: https://ynoproject.net/unaccomplished/

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 Starting the game, Intro cutscene, Messing around in the computer
6:14 Getting Hoverboard, Plastic Bottle, and Games Console PROPERTIES 
10:51 Exploring the Fangame Reference Museum
20:34 Getting Fu PROPERTY, Seeing Beyond the Threshold EVENT, Trying on some Fu designs
27:04 Getting Straw Hat PROPERTY, reaching a cave, realizing I need another Property to explore further
30:47 Getting Glow Stick PROPERTY
32:58 Exploring Dark Cave, Getting Baby PROPERTY, Seeing Chasing Shadows EVENT
42:06 Exploring Sketchbook
47:15 Getting 1-bit PROPERTY
49:09 Getting Emptiness PROPERTY
53:55 Exploring Tetris Maze and completing the Easy PC Game Challenge, Getting Classic PROPERTY and some Yuan
1:04:25 Completing the Difficult PC Game Challenge (jumpcut because i messed up and got lost), Getting ":D" SPECIAL ITEM and more Yuan, Trying on the :D and Classic items
1:17:53 Visiting the Street and the Luxurious Hotel Room, Going back to PC Game, failed attempt to trigger Fake Desktop Event (was locked out of it in my save file), instead collecting Maou's Reward
1:25:30 Seeing Wipeout EVENT
1:30:37 Seeing A Familiar Face EVENT
1:33:10 Getting Wallpaper #11, Exploring Classroom and Invisible Ink, Hitting an NPC repeatedly for some Yuan
1:39:27 Visiting The EYE Shop, Buying the Eye Mask, Return Ticket, and BW Theme ITEMS, Talking to EYE, Finding a secret in the Fu Design Selection Screen, making the Eye Mask usable
1:45:40 Using the Return Ticket
1:47:20 Getting ":|" SPECIAL ITEM
1:49:18 Getting Wallpaper #13
1:50:21 Getting Wallpaper #15
1:53:36 Viewing all the wallpapers, Getting the hidden wallpaper
1:55:32 Reading all the documents

Wuqi Minigame
1:59:00 Starting the minigame
2:00:08 Getting Hoverboard PROPERTY
2:01:07 Getting Straw Hat PROPERTY
2:02:07 Getting Skeleton and Messy PROPERTIES
2:05:07 Getting 1-bit PROPERTY
2:09:00 Getting Emptiness PROPERTY
2:11:36 Exploring White Sand
2:14:08 Getting Games Console PROPERTY, Visiting the Fangames Reference Museum

2:18:41 Yin Ming takes a bow, Fin
